name: Alternate Legends of the Avatar
source:
Alternate Legends of the Avatar is a visual novel, which tells - as the title of the game series suggests - an alternative story about the adventures of the Avatar (and the rest of the characters from the The Last Airbender universe).

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/apexoid]patreon[/url]]

The game seems to have been abandoned.
translation:
《降世神通另类传说》是一部视觉小说，正如系列标题所示，讲述关于《降世神通：最后的气宗》宇宙中降世神通及其他角色冒险的另类故事。

[改编自[url=https://www.patreon.com/apexoid]Patreon[/url]]

本作似乎已经停止开发。
